verdict: Organic presence is active but softening; pipeline work is delayed.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, your Google Business Profiles generated a combined 385 actions — direction requests, web clicks, and calls — with no paid advertising running. Advance Grinding Services was the bright spot, with GBP engagement up 31% week-over-week, while Forte Precision Metals and O'Hare Precision Metals both saw declines of 54% and 20% respectively, and search click volume is softening across all entities. The underlying cause is reduced organic visibility, and a web/SEO fix that was due August 31 is being completed now to address the root issue across all three sites. Several CRM and outreach milestones that gate your pipeline build and email sequences are also past due and are being resolved; once cleared, they unlock the downstream lead generation activity that paid and outreach channels will support.

watch_item.issue: Organic search visibility is declining across all three profiles, and several pipeline-enabling milestones — CRM reconciliation, contact pulls, and the SEO fix — remain open past their due dates.
